name: game_main
comment: Boots the system, builds the heap, starts the input and MOTHER tasks, then runs the task scheduler each vblank.

name: heap_initialize
comment: Allocates 0x11FEF00 bytes and makes them the game heap, its start and end pointers at 0x08C2F4C0 and 0x08C2F4C4.

name: heap_allocate
comment: (alignment, size, unused, flags): flag 2 allocates from the heap's end, flag 1 returns 0 instead of stopping on exhaustion.

name: heap_alloc
comment: heap_allocate(0, size, 0, 0).

name: gu_depth_range
comment: Depth range on the current GU context; set to 0xFFF0..0x10 at 0x0880ACC4.

name: gu_depth_offset
comment: Depth offset on the current GU context; effect_sprite_draw_frame passes an effect's instance +0x22 below 0x199A.

name: gu_tex_func
comment: sceGuTexFunc(tfx, tcc) with the context's colour doubling flag (+0xE4).

name: gu_depth_func
comment: ZTST (0xDE): 1 always, 7 greater-or-equal.

name: gu_depth_mask
comment: ZMSK (0xE7): 1 disables depth writes.

name: gu_blend_func
comment: sceGuBlendFunc(op, src, dst, srcfix, dstfix).

name: gu_set_status_context
comment: sceGuSetStatus: state 0 ATE, 1 ZTE, 3 STE, 4 ABE, 5 BCE, 6 DTE, 7 FGE, 9 TME; 0x15 colour doubling (context +0xE4, TFUNC 0xC9).

name: gu_depth_range_context
comment: sceGuDepthRange(near, far) on a context: +0xD8/+0xDC, viewport Z from their midpoint plus the depth offset.

name: gu_depth_offset_context
comment: sceGuDepthOffset: stores the offset at context +0xE0 and re-emits viewport Z scale/position (0x44/0x47) and NEARZ/FARZ (0xD6/0xD7) with the depth range at +0xD8/+0xDC.

name: light_list_insert
comment: Inserts a light by priority unless already linked (+0xA0), so a repeated lighting record adds no light.

name: effect_sprite_bind
comment: Binds an effect instance: colour 0xFFFFFF, opacity 1, frame table, depth offset at +0x22 from the effect, test state 0x50000 then the blend's.

name: effect_sprite_set_blend
comment: Instance +0x40 = blend table[mode]; +0x48 test state 0x100B for mode 0, else 0x1001 with +0x4C bit 0x20.

name: effect_sprite_draw_frame
comment: Draws one frame of an effect as a camera-facing sprite at a point with the effect's alpha, culled by distance.

name: composition_set_model_test
comment: Per composition child: selector 1 sets TEST low bits 0x1001 (value 0) or 0x100B; 0 sets bit 16; 2 sets bits 14..15.

name: composition_draw
comment: Draws a composition player's models and effects at their composed transforms.

name: model_select_blend
comment: Adds for a model blend 0x48 and subtracts for 0x42 (table 0x08AF1C08: 0x44,0x48,0x42,0x09,0x54); every other entry blends as plain alpha.

name: animation_set_fog_mode
comment: Sets each animated object's fog mode (+0xA8 bits 3..4) and effect flag (+0xDE bit 5); 0x5AA mist passes 1.

name: random_next
comment: Mersenne twister (MT19937) next 32-bit output.

name: random_signed_scaled
comment: scale x signed Mersenne-twister output / 2^31, in -scale..scale.

name: music_request
comment: Requests music row param_1 with its loop and fade arguments.

name: stage_scene_construct
comment: Walks a scene's records by category (type bits 8..15) to UN2's handlers; publishes the scene at battle_manager +0x3D.

name: stage_construct_training_dolls
comment: 0x825: token-5 training dolls at the doll node and its siblings.

name: stage_parse_fog
comment: Category 1: tokens 0..2 colour, 3 near, 4 far, 5 far percentage.

name: stage_parse_lighting
comment: Category 13: light animation, token 5 light count; token 10 R,G,B (not "0") sets the render environment colour, else the light's.

name: stage_parse_animation_props
comment: Category 5: constructs a subtype per record, including UNH2's 0x5A9 lantern lights, 0x5AA mist and 0x5AB translucent layers.

name: stage_glare_apply_scene_row
comment: Copies 20 stage_scene_effect_defaults rows, applies UN2's same overrides to rows 0,1,2,4,9,10, writes enable byte and glare pass +0x64 colour, +0x68 amount, +0x6C second colour.

name: stage_dispatch_prop_effect
comment: Prop effects by type, then the sound at the position: 2 hit spark, 7/8/9 the break effects of stage_break_effect_construct with particle bursts, as UN3's.

name: stage_item_draw
comment: Draws an item kind by cumulative percentage weights, then one of the kind's item codes at random (lists from 0x08B52150).

name: stage_item_drop
comment: Spawns the drawn item; by the items setting 2 a second one at 80% and the given count of extra 0xC chakra items, none at 0 or 1.

name: stage_far_animation_parse
comment: 0x301: token 10 as a Boolean fog mode for the animation's objects.

name: stage_breakable_react
comment: A hit before the last takes the second resource's animation and prop effect 2 with the hit sound; the last the third's, a side's break count and effect 7, 8 or 9 by token 8 (<=100, <=150) with the break sound.

name: stage_breakable_drop_items
comment: Breakable break drop: kinds 5/7/9 at 20/60/20%, two extra chakra items (one on 0x818 bells, none on 0x85E).

name: stage_wind_bell_sway
comment: 0x818: a hit restarts the swing at its amplitude; angle = amplitude x sine step + 0.3 x wind; each completed swing scales the amplitude by 0.6, at least 0.05.

name: stage_monkey_doll_drop_items
comment: 0x826 break drop: kind 2 (items 1, 4, 5, 9, 0xA, 0xB), two extra chakra items.

name: stage_training_doll_parse
comment: 0x825: reappearance base 30 x token 1, record words 6/7 as hit and break sounds, the doll at token 3's node; on scene 10 a broken doll counts for its side.

name: stage_training_doll_schedule
comment: Next reappearance: base - random % (0.4 x base), 181..300 updates for base 300.

name: stage_training_doll_drop_items
comment: 0x825 break drop: kinds 1/4/7/9 at 10/20/50/20%, no extra chakra items.

name: stage_torches_parse
comment: 0x51C: token-5 copies of the token-6 flame at the token-3 node and %s_%d siblings from random frames, an EFF_efe_020_ glow sprite and a spark generator per node, as UN3's 0x517.

name: stage_torches_update
comment: 0x51C: unless restricted, each glow opacity walks by 0.05 within 0.2..0.5 and each flame loops.

name: stage_torches_draw
comment: 0x51C: flames at opacity 0.5, then the EFF_efe_020_ glow at each node at its opacity in draw environment 3, as UN3's.

name: stage_lantern_lights_construct
comment: 0x5A9 constructor: clears the effect, positions, count and opacities.

name: stage_lantern_lights_parse
comment: 0x5A9: token 5 count, token 3 node and its %s_%d siblings, token 6 effect; one effect sprite drawn at each node.

name: stage_lantern_lights_update
comment: 0x5A9: unless stage effects are restricted (0x08898EA4(2)), each opacity walks by random_signed_scaled(0.05) within 0.2..0.5.

name: stage_lantern_lights_draw
comment: 0x5A9: draws frame 0 of the effect at each node at its opacity in draw environment 3.

name: stage_translucent_construct
comment: 0x5AB constructor: clears the composition player.

name: stage_translucent_parse
comment: 0x5AB: token 10 composition in a player, its models' TEST set by composition_set_model_test(1, 0) to 0x1001, no depth writes.

name: stage_translucent_draw
comment: 0x5AB: composition_draw of its player; its update (0x088C49E8) is empty.

name: stage_wind_debris_parse
comment: 0x584: 17 pieces from ANM_s1cgim00..06_n1, the first four with CMP_bre_010/020/030 by animation, as UN3's; s1c2 holds only CMP_bre_000 and _010.

name: stage_wind_debris_update
comment: 0x584: launches pieces only while 0.9 < |wind| < 1 at UN3's odds.

name: stage_directional_wind_parse
comment: 0x585: token 10 x -2 push, five-second initial hold, holds at phases 90/180/270, a 30-second rest at 360, random fixed sign, as UN3's 0x55E.

name: stage_directional_wind_update
comment: 0x585: pushes both fighters (+0x410) by the half-sine strength and places common sound 0x3E, as UN3's.

name: camera_bind_stage_record
comment: Saves the previous stage camera record (+0x180) and binds stage_camera_records_by_scene[scene] at +0x17C.

name: camera_stage_track
comment: Lowers the desired elevation by record +0x4C when sections differ and by +0x50 when either is nonzero, as UN2's 0x001ED960; each tracked point rises by 0.55 of the fighter's scaled height, where UN2's and NA2's rise by 0.75.

name: camera_select_target
comment: NA2's camera_select_target for mode 0; modes 1/2 add 0.6 of the fighter's height and offset by camera_tracking_submode_offsets (+-150 across, +50/-50 up) where NA2 adds +100 and -50/-100.

name: camera_compute_fit
comment: NA2's fit, but the height fit's angle has tangent 64/240 of the half-angle's (half screen height 136 less 72 against half width 240), where NA2's has 120/256: up to 1.76x farther back.

name: camera_place_eye
comment: UN2/NA2 eye placement; then clamps eye height between stage record +0x40 (cap) and +0x44 (floor, read at 0x088EE848): 200 on UN2's scenes, -2000 on scene 19.

name: camera_main_track
comment: Eye smoothing as NA2's camera_main_track; battle manager +0x74 == 1 forces coefficient 0.15625.

name: camera_main_finish_track
comment: Target smoothing as NA2's camera_main_finish_track; battle manager +0x74 == 1 forces coefficient 0.15625.

name: stage_navigation_response
comment: Scenes 1 and 5: a COM in state 5 whose point ahead lies outside its section's endpoints resets, as UN3's on its scenes 1 and 4.

name: ai_route_region_gate
comment: Scene 5 rejects section 0 among secondary navigation points, as UN3's on its scenes 14 and 4.

name: com_think
comment: COM decisions for a fighter whose +0x50 bits 5..8 (COM level) are nonzero, called by each character's AI method; leaves them at +0x8C..+0x94 of the fighter's +0x3C object.

name: stage_navigation_initialize
comment: Collects line extents, then copies the scene's routes until source 0xFF or 64 rows, so a zero-row end is copied with the following rows.

name: stage_break_effect_construct
comment: Break effect variant 1: common effect 1 at scale 1.5; 2: effect 2 at scale 2 and effect 0x44 at scale 2 turned at random; 3: effect 0x3D at scale 2.

name: field_player_placement
comment: Start position and facing from the side's player node raised 200; returns section 1 on scenes 5 and 10, otherwise 0.

name: battle_manager_construct
comment: 0x444-byte battle_manager: scene +0x34, mode +0x38, stage scene +0x3D, fighters +0x3E/+0x3F, COM levels +0x42/+0x43, built fighters +0x1C0/+0x1C4, profile +4.

name: battle_manager_profile
comment: Returns the profile at +4.

name: battle_time_setting
comment: Profile +0x44 halfword, Battle Time; 100 is unlimited.

name: game_scene_update
comment: MOTHER state 5: scene +0x34 1 mode_select_scene_update, 2 dispatches mode +0x38 (5 vs_cpu_mode_update), 5 returns to the title.

name: mode_select_scene_update
comment: Builds and runs Mode Select at mode_select; result 0..5 sets scene 2, mode 2..7 (3: VS CPU, mode 5), 6 scene 3, 7 scene 4, -1 scene 5.

name: battle_build_fighters
comment: Builds both fighters through battle_create_fighter from battle_manager +0x3E/+0x3F, +0x40.., COM levels +0x42/+0x43 and jutsu choices, storing them at +0x1C0/+0x1C4.

name: battle_create_fighter
comment: (battle, character, side, a3, COM level, jutsu, jutsu): the character's constructor from 0x08BC84F0; the COM level becomes fighter +0x50 bits 5..8.

name: item_class
comment: Item code class: 1..7 one, 8..0xC and 0x21 two, 0xD..0x16, 0x23, 0x24, 0x26..0x2B, 0x35..0x3A three, 0x17..0x1B and 0x2C..0x2E four, 0x1C five, 0x1D..0x20 and 0x31..0x34 six, 0x30 seven.

name: mother_task
comment: MOTHER task: builds mother_state, then runs its state each update: 1 logos (mother_logos_update), 2 title (mother_title_update), 5 game (game_scene_update).

name: mother_set_state
comment: Stores the MOTHER state word.

name: mother_logos_update
comment: MOTHER state 1: builds and runs the logos at mother_logos; once logos_running returns 0, frees them and enters state 2.

name: mother_title_update
comment: MOTHER state 2: builds and runs the title at mother_title; result +0xC 0 (New Game) or 1 (Load Game) enters state 5, 2 (timeout) state 1.

name: vs_cpu_mode_update
comment: Builds vs_cpu_mode and runs its sub-state +4: 1 Character Select, 2 vs_cpu_fighter_setup, 3 vs_cpu_battle_update, 4 exit to Mode Select.

name: vs_cpu_character_select_update
comment: VS CPU sub-state 1, Character then Stage Select; its own state +8 starts at 0 and builds the menu; confirm keeps the selection at vs_cpu_mode +0xC..+0x30 and enters sub-state 2, back enters 4.

name: vs_cpu_fighter_setup
comment: VS CPU sub-state 2: side flags, both sides' jutsu choices (+0x44..+0x47), fighter files, then sub-state 3.

name: vs_cpu_battle_update
comment: VS CPU sub-state 3: builds and runs the battle; Battle Time 100 sets battle_manager bit 1 (unlimited); the pause menu's results return to sub-state 1 or 4.

name: stage_scene4_resource_select
comment: Scene 4 takes resource +0x24A0 and environment index 4, other scenes 5, as UN3's stage_scene2_resource_select.

name: profile_new_game_defaults
comment: Control and option defaults; with a1 0 it also copies system data's settings.

name: point_in_rectangle_x_height
comment: True when the point's x lies strictly between corner A's and B's and its height between B's and A's.

name: skill_request_jutsu_camera_end
comment: Jutsu base method: posts request 6 (+0x24) to the jutsu camera (battle +0x1FC), except on scene 5 for kind 5 with the target off section 0 and kinds 0x46 and 0xF above height 500.

name: skill_pair_place_rectangles
comment: Scenes 0, 1, 2, 5 and 13: a participant inside a skill_pair_rectangles row of its scene and section moves to its target row's point by the partner's side; on scene 5's section 0 both move, then the probes place them.

name: skill_pair_scene10_heights
comment: Scene 10 sets both participants' heights to 60.

name: skill_pair_place
comment: Places a jutsu's pair through skill_pair_place_rectangles, else by ground probes at distances per jutsu kind, as UN2's 0x007BEDE0.

name: audio_position_velocity
comment: Returns 0x7F whatever the position: UNH2's positional sounds do not fade with distance.

name: audio_position_direction
comment: Returns 0x3F0000, centred, whatever the position.

name: audio_play_mode_music
comment: Case 5: the scene's stage_music_tracks entry unless the override at 0x08BD06F4 is set.

name: fighter_request_periodic_surface_audio
comment: Footstep event by masked ground: F0F0F0 0xB8, 202020 0xB7, 80D0F0 0, 10C0/5000/3060 1, E0A000/E0E000 5, D000 2, 60C0 6, 90B0C0 4, F0D0D0/606060/8080F0/E000E0 3, else 0x25; every 5 updates (8, 12, 11 for characters 0x15, 0xE, 4).

name: audio_play_common
comment: Plays common event 0..0xD5 through its audio_common_controls row: program, key and velocity.

name: audio_play_common_at
comment: Common event at a position: velocity from audio_position_velocity, always 0x7F, capped by the row's; direction from audio_position_direction, always centred.

name: audio_loop_start
comment: Starts a common event in one of eight loop slots at its row's program, key and velocity; returns the slot handle.

name: audio_loop_stop
comment: Stops a loop slot's sound.

name: audio_loop_place
comment: Empty: a loop's position update changes nothing, so the wind loop keeps its starting level.

name: stage_end_side
comment: 1 when x lies within the distance of the stage's lower end, 2 of its upper end, else 0.

name: skill_camera_bind_preset
comment: Binds a jutsu camera preset (0xB0-byte rows from 0x08BD0840), substituting presets for some jutsu kinds on scenes 12 and 0.

name: jutsu_camera_update
comment: Takes the request word +0x24, dispatches the shot kind, applies the state, then latches +0x24 into +0x28 and clears it.

name: jutsu_camera_select_kind
comment: Sets the shot kind +0x08 from the new mode +0x1C and the jutsu kind +0x10.

name: jutsu_camera_take_request
comment: Turns request +0x24 into a mode: 2 -> 5, 3/4/5 -> 2/3/4 when a fighter's +0x8A0 is set, 6 -> -1 (end the shot).

name: jutsu_camera_dispatch_kind
comment: Runs the shot kind's handler, then jutsu_camera_apply_state.

name: skill_camera_kind13
comment: Jutsu kind 0x13's camera; on scene 5 within 150 of a stage end it takes the scene's own presets.

name: skill_camera_kind1b
comment: Jutsu kind 0x1B's camera; on scene 5 near a stage end it takes the scene's own preset list.

name: jutsu_camera_apply_state
comment: State +0x34: 1 shows the jutsu camera, 0 switches straight back to the battle camera, -1 hands back through 0x088EF004.

name: skill_camera_scene5_high
comment: Scene 5 with both fighters in section 1 and either above height 600: kind 3's camera takes its high presets.

name: logos_construct
comment: Seven sub-states: 1 enters 2 once (flag 0x08BE0170) else 3, 2 logos_system_data_load, 3..5 the logos, which Start skips, 6 done.

name: logos_running
comment: Nonzero until the logos' sub-state is 6.

name: logos_system_data_load
comment: Logos sub-state 2: loads system data from the memory stick through a temporary battle_manager.

name: title_construct
comment: Twelve sub-states: 1..5 build and show the title, 6 title_menu_update, 7 title_confirm_update, 8 and 10 fades, 9 Load Game, 11 done.

name: title_menu_update
comment: Title sub-state 6: New Game (+0x10 = 0) or Load Game (1, the default); confirm enters 7, the 1800-update timeout returns to the logos.

name: title_confirm_update
comment: Title sub-state 7: New Game builds battle_manager, battle_manager_begin, profile_new_game_defaults(profile, 1) and 0x08A090A8, result 0; Load Game enters sub-state 9.

name: stage_choose_combo_anchor
comment: Copies the strictly nearest stage_combo_anchors vector of the requested side to the point; returns side 0 on scenes 1/2/7/8/10, 1 on 3/4/5/12, else the requested side.

name: skill_combo_choose_anchor
comment: Chooses the anchor nearest the first fighter on its section, gives both participants the returned side and places both there, as NA2's skill_combo_choose_anchor.

name: model_blend_alpha_table
comment: PS2 ALPHA values kept as blend identifiers: 0x44, 0x48, 0x42, 0x09, 0x54.

name: music_rows
comment: 12-byte rows: disc path, loop flag, volume; stage00..10, then the other tracks.

name: screen_width_float
comment: 480.0, the screen width the camera's fit and edge angles use.

name: screen_height_float
comment: 272.0, the screen height the camera's fit and edge angles use.

name: stage_effect_intensity
comment: A byte per scene 0..19; UN2's 18 then 0xFF, 0xFF.

name: skill_pair_rectangle_targets
comment: Halfword target row per rectangle row; -1 drops the placement.

name: stage_combo_anchors
comment: 20 0x10-byte records by scene: side 0/1 vector pointers at +0/+4, counts at +8/+9; scenes 16 and 17 share arrays, 18 and 19 have their own.

name: stage_render_coefficients
comment: Two floats per scene 0..19; UN2's 18 then (0.32, 0.3) and (0.45, 0.3).

name: stage_scene_effect_defaults
comment: Screen glare rows by scene, UN2's 18 rows byte-identical, then two zero (disabled) rows for scenes 18 and 19. Override code not traced.

name: stage_scene_tables
comment: 20 pointers (scenes 0..19: UN2's 18, then s8a Outside and s8b Inside the Mugenjo) to UN2-layout 32-byte scene records.

name: stage_camera_records_by_scene
comment: 20 pointers to 22-float camera records: UN2's fields 0..21.

name: camera_tracking_submode_offsets
comment: 150 across, then +50 and -50 up for tracking submodes 1 and 2 (camera_select_target).

name: stage_navigation_authored_routes
comment: 20 pointers to UN2-layout route rows; lists end with a zero row, scenes 18 and 19 reuse scenes 16's and 17's.

name: audio_common_controls
comment: 8-byte rows per common event, UN2's layout: program (-1 none), two bytes, key, velocity, maximum, 0, 1; events 0..0x64 play programs of their own number but 0x61/0x62.

name: skill_pair_rectangles
comment: 32-byte rows of two corner points (x, height ranges), then target rows of two points by side.

name: stage_music_tracks
comment: A word per scene: the music_rows track (stageNN.at3), 0x0F where the disc has no archive.

name: vs_cpu_character_select_vtable
comment: VS CPU sub-state 1's vtable; +8 is vs_cpu_character_select_update.

name: battle_manager
comment: The battle manager, built by New Game; see battle_manager_construct.

name: mode_select
comment: The running Mode Select, or 0.

name: mother_state
comment: The MOTHER state word's holder.

name: mother_logos
comment: The running logos, or 0.

name: mother_title
comment: The running title, or 0.

name: vs_cpu_mode
comment: The VS CPU controller: sub-state +4, its five sub-state objects from +0x48 (vtables 0x08BFBD80..0x08BFBDC0).
